passages.title: Making a Bag from Old Clothes
text: G: I want to buy a new bag.
B: You already have too many bags. In my opinion, you don’t need any more.
G: But I’m bored with my old bags.
B: Then how about using old clothes to make a new bag? You can find out how to do it online.
G: Oh, that sounds interesting! I can’t wait to make my own bag.
